scenes.title: The Journey to the Plate
scenes.summary: At the Claude Monet bar, Max watches dinner guests and discusses with Kostya how diners never realize the immense journey a dish takes to reach their plate.

scenes.title: The Final Touch
scenes.summary: In the kitchen, Chef Viktor Barinov inspects a finished dish at the pass and instructs Max on the art of garnishing plates before they reach the dining room.

scenes.title: The Secret of the Best Products
scenes.summary: As the cooks chop vegetables for dinner service, Chef Viktor Barinov reminds Max that great cooking starts with hand-picking the finest ingredients at the market.

scenes.title: Mutton and Truffles
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov inspects meat from supplier Timur outside the restaurant and haggles over smuggled luxury truffles.

scenes.title: Shaving Arms
scenes.summary: Senya and Fedya play a prank on rookie Max, convincing him that health inspectors require cooks to shave their arms completely bare.

scenes.title: Kitchen Inspection
scenes.summary: Max realizes he fell for a locker room prank while art director Vika confronts Chef Barinov over kitchen mess and inspection rules.

scenes.title: Jokes in the Kitchen
scenes.summary: In the kitchen of Claude Monet, the staff must clean every corner ahead of a surprise health inspection. Pastry chef Louis playfully pretends to duel Max with a giant stick of sausage before they start wiping down the dusty storage shelves.

scenes.title: Rotten Potato
scenes.summary: While cleaning out the darkest corner behind the kitchen storage shelves, Max and Kostya discover an old blue plastic bag. Unaware that it contains Chef's prized luxury truffles, they examine the strange lumpy objects and assume they are rotten potatoes.

scenes.title: A Hair on the Plate
scenes.summary: In the elegant dining room of Claude Monet, an indignant diner summons waitress Nastya over to his table. He points out a long stray hair in his meal, sparking a hilariously deadpan exchange with the unflappable waitress.

scenes.title: An Urgent Cleanup
scenes.summary: Alerted to a surprise health inspection, Chef Barinov and sous-chef Lyova frantically order the kitchen staff to clean worktops and hide unapproved items.

scenes.title: The Inspector's Visit
scenes.summary: Victoria leads the unyielding health inspector from the spotless dining room into the kitchen, nervously preparing him for the kitchen examination.

scenes.title: A Strict Inspection
scenes.summary: The inspector examines the cooking stations alongside a defensive Chef Barinov, pointing out slippery floors, open bottles, and threatening severe penalties.

scenes.title: An Unexpected Find
scenes.summary: In the back courtyard of Claude Monet, Max and Kostya are desperately searching the garbage for the restaurant's lost truffles. Suddenly, an eccentric homeless gentleman appears holding the empty container and offers a surprising bargain.

scenes.title: Bargaining Is Inappropriate
scenes.summary: Inside the restaurant staff locker room, Kostya tries to talk the eccentric homeless man Rodion out of dining in the luxurious dining room. Despite Kostya's frantic protests, Rodion remains completely unyielding and demands his five-star meal.

scenes.title: The Writer Viktor Pelevin
scenes.summary: To sneak the eccentric Rodion into Claude Monet's dining room, Max hatches a bold scheme and calls the restaurant desk to reserve a table for the reclusive writer Viktor Pelevin. As Kostya worries that their cover will be blown, Rodion puts on dark glasses to complete the disguise.

scenes.title: The Famous Writer
scenes.summary: Kostya feels deeply awkward pretending to be famous writer Viktor Pelevin, but Max insists the disguise will work.

scenes.title: The Inspector's Secret
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov figures out that the strict health inspector quit drinking, so he sends Sasha to offer him fine wine on the house.

scenes.title: The Secret Ingredient
scenes.summary: When the inspector refuses alcohol, Chef Barinov orders pastry chef Louis and the kitchen crew to spike every course with booze.

scenes.title: The Truffle Order
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov demands a fresh truffle salad for a VIP inspector, prompting a panicked Max to beg waitress Nastya to convince the guest to change his order.

scenes.title: Until Next Easter
scenes.summary: Furious over the delay, Chef Barinov threatens to fire Max if the missing truffle is not delivered to the pass within one minute.

scenes.title: Scandal in the Restaurant
scenes.summary: After a drunken guest causes a chaotic brawl in the dining room and assaults author Viktor Pelevin, Vika confronts Chef Barinov, who cynically considers the brawl fantastic publicity for the restaurant.

scenes.title: The Truffle Bill
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov confronts Max after discarded black truffles are retrieved from the trash. Max confesses his ignorance of gourmet mushrooms, prompting Barinov to hand him the expensive dinner bill.

scenes.title: An Unexpected Turn
scenes.summary: Barinov assigns Max to pay off the exorbitant truffle bill, prompting Max to reflect philosophically on life trials and resilience.
